propositions: plan_review/workflow_ops.py and llm/config.py (794 and 793 LOC respectively) lack headroom guards while gate_dispatch.py and orchestrator.py have them; unguarded hot files enable module regrowth

STEP_REGISTRY membership for plan_review_prerequisite_verify_inputs depends on a single import chain with no static assertion; a routine unused-import cleanup would silently unregister the step and remain invisible to schema, linter, and test_contracts.py

test_gate_dispatch_seam.py assertion justifies itself with finalize_verdict call sites in gate_dispatch.py, but those sites were moved to plan_review_recovery.py and workflow_ops.py (zero remain in gate_dispatch)

subprocess isolation is required to test registry membership on a first import; in-process checks run after other tests import prerequisite_workflow_ops are masked by that test import rather than observing the production import

gates/plan-review.yaml contains uses: steps that must be verified against STEP_REGISTRY, but gate-YAML resolution depends on the same process-global registry and suffers identical masking as in-process membership checks
